study: Action-Chunked Behavior Cloning and Residual SAC

research_questions.RQ1: Does H4 action chunking change BC grasping performance with matched training data and observations?
research_questions.RQ2: Does closed-loop SAC residual improve H4 BC more reliably than H1 BC?
research_questions.RQ3: How do action chunking, rescue, regression, and variability interact across BC/SAC seeds?
research_questions.RQ4: Does H4 reduce BC inference frequency while increasing demand for within-chunk SAC corrections?

hypotheses: Chunking may improve temporal consistency or reduce responsiveness.
Stepwise residual SAC may correct open-loop chunk errors.
H4 plus SAC may reduce regressions or increase net improvement relative to its own H4 BC baseline.
BC and SAC seed effects may be heterogeneous; no superiority is assumed.

dataset.combine_rule: concatenate original unsampled train and wide successful episodes; remap wide episode IDs +200
dataset.split: fixed shared episode-level split from action_chunking_data_audit.json
dataset.fair_dataset_excluded: fair_wide_expert.npz is randomly subsampled and has nonconsecutive observation times; never use for H4 targets

H1.output: one XYZ tanh action and one gripper logit

H4.output: 4 XYZ tanh actions and 4 gripper logits

common_training.early_stopping: held-out demonstration validation loss, patience 15, min improvement 1e-6
common_training.loss: mean SmoothL1 XYZ + 0.25 * mean binary cross-entropy gripper
common_training.observation_normalization: mean/std fit on training episode observations only; std floor 1e-4
common_training.train_start_observations: same H4-valid start windows for H1 and H4
common_training.H4_targets: action[t:t+4], same episode and 0.1s adjacent time continuity
common_training.extra_supervision: H4 has four action targets per start versus one for H1

bc_models.checkpoint_selection: lowest held-out demo validation loss; no Final access

sac.chunk_phase: H1 always 0; H4 current index/(H-1), values 0, 1/3, 2/3, 1
sac.reward: same shaped reward terms as existing BCResidualEnv

crossed_design.unit: BC-seed × SAC-seed crossed within each architecture; not 18 independent BC replications

periodic_training_eval.purpose: training diagnostics only; not checkpoint selection

evaluation.SAC_checkpoint_eval: all 10k/20k/30k on shared SAC validation; select separately for each (architecture, BC seed, SAC seed)
checkpoint_rule: fewest regressions against corresponding BC on the same validation positions
evaluation.final_sac_configs: all 18 crossed SAC models evaluated at fixed 30k and selected step; identical checkpoints evaluated once and reused
evaluation.BC_final_baselines: H1/H4 x BC seed; reuse identical BC rollouts across associated SAC seeds
evaluation.sac_checkpoint_paired_bc_baseline: Evaluate every H1/H4 BC seed on the SAC checkpoint Validation positions 280000-280499; compute checkpoint-selection regressions only against the same-position BC result. The separate BC architecture validation remains 270000-270499.

secondary: first gripper close and closed fraction
metrics.compute: SAC is always active; no inference-saving claim for SAC calls; H4 is expected to reduce BC replanning frequency only

statistics.hierarchy: crossed BC seed and SAC seed; positions are paired/reused, not independent training replicates
statistics.descriptive: per BC seed, per SAC seed, per architecture cell, mean and sample SD across seed factors; report all individual cells
statistics.primary_uncertainty: 10,000-replicate hierarchical bootstrap: resample 3 BC seed indices and 3 SAC seed indices independently with replacement, form Cartesian 3x3 crossed cells per replicate; percentile 95% intervals
statistics.position_tests: two-sided exact McNemar per paired initial position for BC-vs-SAC and H1-vs-H4 BC comparisons; Holm correction within architecture and fixed/selected comparison families
statistics.no_pseudoreplication: 2,000 positions are not independent model-training seeds; only 3 BC and 3 SAC seeds limit population inference

limitations: Single Franka grasping task and lightweight state MLP; not ACT or Diffusion Policy.
Source trajectories are successful scripted expert demonstrations.
Only three BC and three SAC seeds.
H4 receives four times as many future action labels per starting state.
Horizon H=4 is a single preregistered chunk size.
SAC always acts each step and the task remains simulation-only.
related_work: Ankile et al., From Imitation to Refinement — Residual RL for Precise Assembly, arXiv:2407.16677.
Ankile et al., Residual Off-Policy RL for Finetuning Behavior Cloning Policies, arXiv:2509.19301.

protocol_amendments.reason: Checkpoint regression counts must compare SAC and its paired BC policy on identical initial positions. The previously specified BC validation positions 270000-270499 are disjoint from SAC checkpoint validation positions 280000-280499.
protocol_amendments.change: Add a BC-only rollout for each of the six frozen BC models on 280000-280499, stored separately and used only to compute paired checkpoint-selection regression counts. All other conditions, including the disjoint Final range, remain as preregistered.
